title: swisseph-ffi: swisseph_azalt missing lapse_rate parameter
description:
The Rust `Ephemeris::azalt` signature includes `lapse_rate: f64` but the C FFI `swisseph_azalt` omits it, hardcoding the default (standard atmosphere 0.0065 K/m). Callers of the FFI cannot control atmospheric lapse rate for refraction in horizon coordinate transforms.

Either add `lapse_rate` to the `swisseph_azalt` C ABI signature, or document this as an intentional simplification.

Ref: swisseph-rs-dart/34 codex review, `docs/api-surface.md` lines 1265-1268 (Rust) vs 2091-2096 (FFI).
execution_record: Added lapse_rate: f64 to swisseph_azalt FFI signature (between attemp and xin), passed through instead of hardcoded 0.0. Threaded through all four Dart layers: bindings_native, bindings_web, marshal, ephemeris body (default 0.0). All azalt differential tests pass. api-surface.md updated.
